[Benzinga news, 2026-10-28T13:33:23Z, by staff] Fortive Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Raises Full-Year Guidance
Fortive Corporation announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results, reporting revenue of $1.108 billion and adjusted earnings per share of $0.77, while raising its full-year 2026 adjusted earnings outlook.
Fortive Corporation reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.108 billion, an increase of 7.9% compared to $1.027 billion in the same period last year. The company achieved adjusted earnings per share of $0.77, surpassing the FactSet consensus estimate of $0.70. Driven by strong year-to-date performance, management raised its full-year 2026 adjusted earnings guidance to a range of $3.10 to $3.14 per share, up from the previous forecast of $2.95 to $3.05 per share. Leadership attributed the results to the successful execution of the 'Fortive Accelerated' strategy, noting core growth of over 7% and adjusted EBITDA growth of approximately 10% for the quarter.
